Remove Schools from a Class List

Source: R/manual_class_list_functions.R
remove_school_from_class_list.Rd

Removes all records belonging to one or more specified schools, identified by school name, URN, or both.

Supports the package's configurable column-name system. School names are identified preferentially using `est_name`, falling back to `est_wonde_name` when unavailable.

When both school names and URNs are supplied, rows matching either criterion are removed.

Usage

remove_school_from_class_list(
  data,
  school_names = NULL,
  URNs = NULL,
  SchoolNameColumn = NULL,
  URNColumn = "urn",
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A class-list data frame using configured or internal column names.

school_names

Character vector of school names to remove. Optional when `URNs` is supplied.

URNs

Character or numeric vector of URNs to remove. Optional when `school_names` is supplied.

SchoolNameColumn

Optional character string specifying the school-name column. Accepts an internal key, configured name, or literal column name. Defaults to NULL, which preferentially selects `est_name`, falling back to `est_wonde_name`.

URNColumn

Character string identifying the URN column. Accepts an internal key, configured name, or literal column name. Defaults to `"urn"`.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, reports the number of rows and schools removed.

Value

A data frame containing the remaining class-list records, with column names restored to the configured naming convention.

Details

Both school names and URNs are matched exactly. URNs are converted to character before matching so numeric and character identifiers can be compared.

Missing values are not used as removal criteria.

See also

Other class_list: add_student_to_school_class(), clean_teacher_names(), create_school_blanks(), produce_class_lists(), reduce_to_best_teacher(), remove_class(), remove_student_from_class(), update_class_name(), update_class_teacher(), update_school_name(), update_student_class()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Remove by school name
updated <- remove_school_from_class_list(
  class_list,
  school_names = "Greenfield Primary School"
)

# Remove by URN
updated <- remove_school_from_class_list(
  class_list,
  URNs = c(123456, 987654)
)

# Remove by either school name or URN
updated <- remove_school_from_class_list(
  class_list,
  school_names = "Riverside Primary",
  URNs = 123456
)
} # }
